{{Quote|You come for the Shining Man. Come for his machine that fell from the stars.|Xanar|<ref name="Shining" />}}
'''Xanar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] living on [[Voss]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He was the first to witness the [[Albathius|Shining Man]], also known as Albathius, land in the [[Chamber of Ashes]]. Intrigued by the offworlder, Xanar obsessively studied him from afar as the Shining Man spent three moons studying the Voss ways and fabricated a prophecy and was changed by the experience, before eventually departing to join Voss culture. Though the Shining Man set his starship to self-destruct to erase any evidence, Xanar managed to [[Slicer/Legends|slice]] its computer. Using computer, he learned to speak [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] and learned much of the world beyond Voss, distancing him even further from his people. He patiently waited for the Shining Man's return near his [[Starship/Legends|starship]] in the [[Dark Heart]] of the [[Nightmare Lands]] for many moons. Finally, another outsider came - [[Cipher Nine]] of the [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]]. Xanar approached the new outsider, demanding the Imperial take him to the Shining Man, who he wanted to meet to learn his techniques of infiltration, in exchange for the data in his ship. Upon hearing Cipher Nine claim that the Shining Man had died, Xanar rejected it as a lie, after which the Gormak attacked and tried to kill the agent, only for his opponent to fatally wound him. With his dying breath, Xanar reactivated the Shining Man's starship's self-destruct in an attempt to kill Cipher Nine. After Xanar expired, Cipher Nine quickly retrieved the data from his body and fled to avoid being caught in the explosion.<ref name="Shining" />

The [[Star Cabal]] was aware of Xanar's existence, referring to him as their "special Gormak friend."<ref name="Road to Ruin">{{TORcite|type=class|Imperial Agent|Road to Ruin|[[Dromund Kaas]]}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
===Gameplay alternatives===
As Xanar is dying, the player has three dialogue options with him:
*Neutral dialogue mocks the Gormak to stay and die while the Imperial Agent makes off with his data.<ref name="Shining" />
*Light side dialogue will have the Imperial Agent offering to save Xanar, but the Gormak merely laughs off the offer.<ref name="Shining" />
*Dark side dialogue results in the player executing Xanar.<ref name="Shining" />
